workload.description: Feed a parser a long incomplete markup sequence and then signal end of input.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 against a public export of the pinned patched snapshot at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; correctness assertions passed and marker_probe observed the target region.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises HTMLParser.goahead with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
